method: Viewed both exact exported USDZ Apple SceneKit PNGs individually using functions.view_image; compared new model raw and canonical data. No render or geometry edits.
observations: The visible asset is intersecting upright slabs/cross-like panels, not a chair with a thin horizontal seat, rear backrest and four supporting feet.
The model chose seat dimensions0.5width,0.45height,0.1depth: the requested approximate seat elevation was confused with seat solid thickness.
Legs attach to left/right/front/back faces with center anchors, not bottom support faces. The back attaches to front, not rear.
The declared #5B5B5B gray does not match the requested brown wood; bright white preview appearance is not by itself a proven phone rendering defect.
scope: One accepted native-format asset only; no visual acceptance, no phone test.
